audience: developers and teams who track repositories, pull requests and CI runs in GitHub

useCases.title: Check open pull requests and failing workflow runs
useCases.text: List the pull requests of a repository and read one with its reviews. List the workflow runs to see which ones failed.

useCases.title: Review the files changed in a pull request
useCases.text: Read a pull request with its branches and state. Then read its changed files with the patch text and the commits on its branch.

useCases.title: Find issues and read their discussion
useCases.text: Search issues and pull requests with GitHub qualifiers such as repo, label or state. Open one issue and read its comments.

useCases.title: Open a bug report and add the steps to reproduce
useCases.text: Create a new issue in a repository. Then add a comment with the steps to reproduce it. Everyone who can read the repository sees both.

useCases.title: Find popular repositories by topic
useCases.text: Search public and accessible repositories with qualifiers such as language or stars. Open one to read its default branch and last push time.
